mode_evidence: One light is said to appear 'as witnessing and seeing, more evident than the sun'; others come with bodily sensations (hot water over the head, numbness in the brain, a grip on the head) and thunder-like sound. He also describes suspended images (muthul mu'allaqa) seen by the self, distinct from the brain, so these are not mind's-eye pictures. Eyes open or closed are not specified.
onset_evidence: Para. 276 lists aids that lead to these states: closeness to God, little food, vigil, supplication, refining the inner self with subtle thoughts, grasping signs in creation, constant dhikr to God's majesty, sincerity toward the Light of Lights, singing God's remembrance, reading revealed scripture, promptness in return to the Lord. In the Testament, forty days of discipline: no meat, little food, devoted to contemplation of God's light, before studying the book. A flashing light 'comes to beginners', so some light is expected early. No time scale except the forty days.

conditions.setting: Retreat of forty days; sanctuaries of prayer.
conditions.duration_and_schedule: Forty days before taking up the book; vigil and reduced food generally.
conditions.prerequisites: Training in the Peripatetic way and a love of God's light; guidance of the 'keeper of the book' for the secret.

stages.label: flashing light for beginners
stages.description: A pleasant light that gleams and folds away like a lightning flash.

stages.label: great flash
stages.description: A greater, fearful flash, possibly with thunder-like sound or roar in the brain.

stages.label: hot-water light
stages.description: A pleasant light arriving like hot water poured on the head.

stages.label: fixed light
stages.description: A long-lasting forceful light with numbness in the brain.

stages.label: love light
stages.description: A very pleasant light with sweet joy, moved by love.

stages.label: burning light
stages.description: A light that burns, moved by the power of might.

stages.label: sun-surpassing flash
stages.description: A light in a great snatch, seen 'more evident than the sun', in overwhelming delight.

stages.label: hair-hanging light
stages.description: A brilliant light that seems attached to the hair of the head.

stages.label: grip lights
stages.description: Lights with a grasp that pulls the head or is fixed in the brain.

stages.label: body-clothing light
stages.description: A light that shines from the soul over the whole spirit, so that the body seems clothed in it.

stages.label: heavy and forceful lights
stages.description: A light with unbearable weight; a light with force that nearly dislocates the joints.

what_to_do_with_light: Treat these as the attainments of the intermediate: reflections of the governing light on the body. Beyond them is the great 'habit of death', passing into the world of light. Lights tinged with might or love are useful for corresponding effects.
obstacles_and_fixes: Fearsome flashes and sounds may frighten beginners or come from thought and imagination; the text notes some burning lights bring dreadful drums and horns for the beginner.
cautions: Keep the book from those who are not fit; no one should expect to learn its secrets without the keeper of the book.
Lights are not the goal: the highest state is separation of the governing light from darkness.
interpretation: The lights are illuminations on the governing light, reflected into the body; they are way-stations on the path to the Light of Lights.
practice_summary: Sources of the lights, as Suhrawardi lists them: nearness to God by reduced food, vigil and supplication; refining the inner self with subtle thoughts; reading signs in the world as pointers to God; constant dhikr of God's majesty; sincerity toward the Light of Lights; reading revealed books. Before studying his book, keep forty days of discipline: no meat, little food, contemplate God's light. The lights that may come: first a pleasant flash for beginners; then stronger flashes with a thunder-like noise; a light like hot water over the head; a lasting one with numbness; a sweet light of love; a burning light; a flash brighter than the sun; a light seemingly hanging from the hair; lights that grip the head; a light clothing the body. These are the goals of the intermediate, not of the end.

key_passages.paraphrase: The brethren of detachment receive lights of many kinds; the list begins with a pleasant flashing light for beginners.

key_passages.anchor: يظهر مشاهدةً وإبصاراً أظهر من الشمس
key_passages.paraphrase: One light appears as witnessing and seeing, more evident than the sun, in overwhelming delight.
Reduced food, vigil and supplication, with constant dhikr and sincerity toward the Light of Lights, lead to these states.

key_passages.anchor: وقبل الشروع يرتاض أربعين يوم تاركاً للحوم
key_passages.paraphrase: Before starting the book, forty days of discipline without meat, eating little, devoted to contemplation of God's light.
